summary: EagleRock Land, LLC filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 17,300,000 Class A shares at $18.50 per share, with an additional 2,595,000 shares purchased via an underwriter option, closing May 15 and May 19, 2026. The offering was registered on Form S-1 and underwritten by Goldman Sachs, Barclays, and J.P. Morgan. Net proceeds of ~$333.1 million will be used per the prospectus. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No board recommendation, M&A terms, or activism is involved. The filing is a standard secondary or primary offering with no event-driven investment angle.
